description.value: Deacon's Corner is a southern-style comfort food restaurant that has anchored the Gastown neighbourhood since 2009, inspired by a truck stop diner on the Trans-Canada Highway outside Winnipeg. The menu leans heavily on hearty all-day breakfast dishes — fried chicken, eggs every style, biscuits, hash bowls, and bennys — made in-house from scratch with generous portions. The restaurant describes itself as a 'perfect pit stop for explorers,' and its brunch-focused format suits a mid-ride refuel well.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Deacon's Corner is an active southern-style comfort food restaurant in Gastown, open since 2009, with takeout and delivery options explicitly listed on the order page. The menu includes clearly vegetarian dishes (Veggie scramble, Veggie hash bowl, Avocado Toast). No bike-specific amenities, washroom details, water refill, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the website; OSM tags add no relevant amenity data either. A postal code discrepancy exists: OSM has V6A 2S5 while the website consistently shows V6A 1B8.
